versions.changelog: 搜索优化：名称纳入「违禁词/敏感词」高频检索词，提升关键词搜索命中率
搜索优化：description 扩写至 376 字符（问题导向+同义词+用户原话触发短语）、触发词扩至 16 个、README 首屏重构、7 平台词库说明补全

Initial release of content-compliance-review skill providing comprehensive content compliance checks across six major platforms.

- Supports compliance review for Video Accounts, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou, Bilibili, and WeChat Official Accounts.
- Implements multi-step automated checks: local prohibited words (platform-specific), platform rule matching, privacy detection, and excessive commitment scans.
- Outputs detailed, structured audit reports with modification suggestions.
- Integrates both general and platform-specific sensitive word libraries; avoids cross-platform rule application.
- Includes small program triggers and explicit publication pre-checklists for regulated content publishing.
